title: The Trigger daily snapshot
description: One file per day in data/YYYY-MM-DD.json. Files without schemaVersion predate version 1 and have the same shape. A change to any field is a new schemaVersion, recorded in the changelog below.
$comment: Changelog. v1 (2026-11): adds schemaVersion; no other change from the unversioned files written 2026-10-14 to 2026-11-06.

schemaVersion.description: File format version. Absent means version 0, which has the same fields as version 1.

date.description: Snapshot date. Equals the file name.

revision.description: 0 for the first write of a date; each correction or same-day rescore adds 1.

bandMonths.description: Half-width of the uncertainty band, in months.

sourceCoveragePct.description: Share of sources that returned live data.

weightCovered.description: Share of index weight fed by a value.

subIndices.description: Sub-index scores, 0 to 100, or null when no metric fed it.

sourcesSkipped.description: Not attempted because a required key was not configured.

metricId.description: Stable key, unique within a snapshot.

asOf.description: Date of the underlying observation, not the fetch.

sourceUrl.description: Deep link to the record the value came from.

stale.description: True when the source failed and this is the previous snapshot's value carried forward.

revision.description: Upstream revision counter, when the publisher revises.
